kindHint.npcs: A unique person exists once per game; an archetype as many times as the story needs.
kindHint.locations: A unique place exists once per game; an archetype stands for any place of its kind.
kindHint.items: A unique item exists once per game; an archetype as many times as the story needs.

descriptionHint: One line of English for the model, never shown to the player.

generic.npcs: Generic: stands for anyone the player runs into
generic.items: Generic: stands for anything the player picks up

combatHint: JSON: skills in percent by reference, hitPointsMax, and the item reference of the ordinary weapon (or null).
parentHint: The named place that contains this one, if any.
stackable: Stackable: copies are interchangeable and counted by quantity
initialHolder: Held when the game starts by
initialHolderHint: A named person or place; the item comes into being with them.
modifiersHint: JSON list: each with target "skill", the skill, a value in percent (±20 for a tool of quality), condition (owned or equipped) and description.
weaponHint: JSON, empty for anything that is no weapon: the skill it is wielded with, its damage dice (1D6+1), how much of the wielder's damage modifier it adds (full, half or none) and its special effect (bleeding, crushing, entangling, impaling, knockback, or null).

intro.npcs: The people the scene can hold. The model picks from this list and never invents someone with a state of their own.
intro.locations: The places of the world, named or generic. A movement names a named place, or a new place of an archetype.
intro.items: The items of the world. The model picks from this list and never makes up an item.
